# Initialize cache-listener phase flags independently of Init

nsImapCacheStreamListener now starts with mCache2=false and mStarting=true in its constructor. Init separately retains the channel and listener in nsCOMPtr members and sets cache2 mode and starting state. Its definition and implementation are in nsImapProtocol.cpp, and the source explicitly limits the listener to the UI thread. Preserve constructor-safe state without claiming that these booleans make the class thread-safe. This is static initialization evidence, not an exercised uninitialized read. Complete Bugzilla and historical Phabricator timeline/inline discussion remains pending.

Scope: mailnews / imap.
